description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for the CalcMate application, managing the application state, layout, and rendering child components for input, history, export, and alerts.

methods.name: addCalculation
methods.description: Updates the calculation history with a new calculation object, maintaining a maximum of 20 items, and sets the current calculation.

methods.name: showAlert
methods.description: Sets an alert message and clears it after 3400 milliseconds.
